intro: A slice of chocolate cake is about 400 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from sugar, butter and the chocolate frosting or ganache on top and in the middle.

variants.name: Chocolate lava cake with thick sauce

diet: Yes, but plan for it. 400 kcal a slice is close to a plate of rice with light dishes. At an office birthday, take a small slice and enjoy it slowly. Usually the problem isn't the first slice, it's the second and third.
tips: Ask for a thin slice or share half with a friend.
Scrape off some of the thick frosting if it's too sweet.
Pair it with kopi O or teh O kosong, not a sweet drink.

swap.name: Small brownie or 2 squares of dark chocolate
swap.why: You still get your chocolate fix, with less than half the calories.

faq.q: Is steamed chocolate cake healthier than baked?
faq.a: Not really. The cooking method doesn't change calories much. What matters is the sugar, oil and toppings.

faq.q: How long does chocolate cake last in the fridge?
faq.a: Usually 3 to 5 days in a covered container. Cakes with fresh cream spoil faster.

faq.q: Why does moist chocolate cake taste oily?
faq.a: Moist recipes often use more cooking oil than butter to keep the cake soft. That's why it feels a bit oily.
